verdict.rationale: Reflect documents a limited external API with OAuth 2 and PKCE, so developers can build their own clients. That API only appends data to notes and lists bookmarked links, plus custom-URL deep links. There is no evidence of an in-app plugin or extension SDK, and a community user notes Reflect works 'without any plugins'. Probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an in-app plugin/extension API or SDK, sample code, in-depth developer docs or an API reference spec, and broader API coverage beyond appending and bookmark listing.
